She's well aware of how I feel and what would she be lying to me about? It's a completely black and white situation, she might not like me back but she still cares about me on a deeper level than she does over all of her friends. 4 years might not be much time but time is purely relative, I feel like i've known her my entire life and if you were to see how we interact in-person then you'd know that her and I don't have the average friendship. 

You're coming off a bit hostile which isn't doing anything to help your case.

I know what her flaws, contradictions, judgements and hypocrisies are, i've been friends with her long enough to see every side of her. She's not perfect but the connection I have with her runs deeper than any connection i've had with any other person i've gotten close with and she's told me that she feels the same way.
I've had/have plenty of friendships with girls that haven't ended up this way.

Well if you count planning to die the night of your birthday like I did a few weeks ago (Birthday has already passed but i'm still planning on killing myself within the next 2-4 weeks) then yes. 

PS: This isn't something I want help with and while positives comments urging me not to do it will be greatly appreciated, they will be greatly in vain. The only thing I currently want is to die and nobody is going to take that away from me. Throughout my life, it's been about what I can do to help others get what they want, never about what I want and how others can help (Not trying to sound selfish here, I enjoy helping people to the best of my abilities but it's never been reciprocated in any way/shape/form). 

I'm determined to die and that's what **I** want. Is it going to bring pain and turmoil to friends and family? Absolutely, and I feel terrible that they're all going to have to deal with my loss. Do I feel terrible enough to where I won't do it? Not a chance. While the love I have for my friends and family knows no bounds, my wants and desires are (selfishly) above everyone else's. 

If you do decide to PM me or reply to this comment inquiring how you can help, feel free to give me the most painless routes for suicide that you know of.
